issues.problem: The explanation says "Data-center designs, including NICo's, use eBGP on every link." The docs only require eBGP unnumbered on leaf switches facing DPUs (plus multi-hop eBGP to route servers) and say to follow RFC 7938. They make no claim about the leaf–spine links, which the network team owns.
issues.fix: Reword to: "RFC 7938-style data-center designs use eBGP on every link, and NICo requires eBGP unnumbered on every leaf port facing a DPU."
